# Blue Ocean Hub: Strategic Financial Intelligence

> South Asia's premier financial magazine and intelligence publication. Delivering elite cashflow allocation, personal wealth building, and international currency hedging blueprints for founders, freelancers, and entrepreneurs.

Explore our comprehensive guides, research papers, and strategic action plans for navigating complex tax codes and compounding international revenues.

## Core Intelligence Categories

- [Passive Income](/passive-income) - Leveraged cashflow strategies, digital niche assets, and physical estate comparison blueprints.
- [Investing](/investing) - Strategic local equity selection (PSX), Shariah-compliant mutual funds, Voluntary Pension Schemes, and gold.
- [Freelancing](/freelancing) - Technical agency scaling, international client billing structures, contract engineer option pools, and B2B client acquisition.
- [Saving Money](/saving-money) - FBR tax filing guides, employee provident fund structures, tax rebates, and wealth statement filings.
- [Dollar Earning](/dollar-earning) - Onshore US business banking setup, foreign entities, Stripe integration alternatives (Lemon Squeezy, Paddle), and GCC SaaS monetization.
